long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Ben van Loo saw a business opportunity in the way his son's London accommodation was used. Students occupied it for part of the year, with business travellers and tourists filling the remaining months. He wanted to organise that flexible letting more professionally, combining compact private studios with generous shared spaces.

His A-Stay venture partnered with construction group BESIX to develop the model. At its first Antwerp hotel, guests could check themselves in and choose which additional services to buy. Routine administration was automated, while staff handled more complex requests and helped guests in the communal lobby. Daily cleaning was an optional extra rather than part of the basic room price.
